title: compare/1: every feature against the reference and the blank
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli table compare` and the output of the Flow step `table.compare@1`, byte for byte. Each feature of a time-course table against its reference columns (t0) and its blank columns: levels, ratios (x + pc) / (y + pc), log2 fold changes, the shape over time and the time course of the blank, and a class that only sorts and filters; every row is kept, in the order of the table. Class rules, the first that matches decides: 1 no_signal: max_treated <= pseudocount; 2 blank_artefact: ratio_blank < factor (reason blank_level) or blank_rho >= rho_min with the blank maximum above the pseudocount (reason blank_rises); 3 candidate: absent_in_reference or ratio_ref >= factor (reasons absent_in_reference, above_reference); 4 decreasing: ratio_ref <= 1/factor or shape falls (reasons below_reference, falls); 5 unchanged. no_signal carries the reason below_pseudocount. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/statcmp.rs, crates/mzlab-feat/src/flow_compare.rs.

table.description: The table read: the file name as given (no folder), the SHA-256 of its bytes, its rows (features) and columns (files).

roles.description: The columns of each role: the reference and blank selectors as given and what they matched; every other column is treated.

params.description: The values used. The pseudocount is in the unit of the quantity; its origin is given (--pseudocount), blanks (3 x the median of the positive blank values), reference or floor.

choices.description: Every default used, the time of every column (key time:NAME, the reason is its origin: samples, name or none), the pseudocount with its origin and the class rules.

id.description: The id of the CSV row, or the 1-based row number of a .mzfeat.

max_file.description: The treated column with the maximum.

t_max_min.description: Time of the maximum of the per-time means; null without times.

rho.description: Spearman of the treated time course against time.

blank_rho.description: Spearman of the blank columns against their times; null with fewer than 3 timed blanks.
